groups.defect: On the credential-sync path, refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch Response. Callers that expect a parsed token object (Google reads res?.data then token.access_token; s_95177b03 also names the hubspot and zoho callers) get undefined and throw.

answer.reasoning: All four suggestions describe the same mismatch. When sharing is on, refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch Response, but the Google Calendar caller reads it as parsed data (`res?.data`), so it breaks. Two members point at the helper and two at the Google call site, so this is a cross_location group. Both judges agree on the grouping. They only disagree on needsUnifiedComment. s_95177b03 goes further than the others: it says the hubspot caller (which treats the result as a HubspotToken) and the zoho-bigin and zohocrm callers (which read tokenInfo.data.error) are also broken. Those are separate call sites. s_d23711df and s_0b9819e3 add that office365, zoom, webex and lark already expect a Response. So a fix inside the helper alone does not cleanly solve every case, and the merged comment has to cover both the helper and the call sites, including hubspot and zoho. That makes needsUnifiedComment true. The grouping itself is clear, but whether the unified-comment flag should be true is a judgment call, so decisive is false.
